items.detail: Join us and compete in a jigsaw competition! Grab your team and get ready to compete against other teams to see who can complete the same jigsaw puzzle the fastest. The first three teams to finish the puzzle the fastest will win a prize. Pre-registration is required. Each participant will receive a slice of pizza and a drink. For the Family Holiday Puzzle Palooza: each family team will receive a large cheese pizza and a drink. Ages: All Location: Twin Lakes Multipurpose Room Register Now CODE TYPE DAY DATE TIME FEE 103000-03 Family Holiday 300-piece puzzle Friday 12/18/26 5:45-8:00 pm $43NR/$38R per family up to 6 people. Each team must include a minimum of two kids age 14 or under.
items.title: Holiday Puzzle Palooza
